proof_body:
by
  intro K L _ _ _ _ h
  haveI : LieAlgebra.IsKilling K L := ⟨by
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro x hx
    rw [LieIdeal.mem_killingCompl] at hx
    have hx0 : x = 0 := h.1 x (fun y => by
      rw [LieModule.traceForm_comm]
      exact hx y (LieSubmodule.mem_top y))
    simp [hx0]⟩
  infer_instance
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) (L : Type*) [Field K] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L], (killingForm K L).Nondegenerate → LieAlgebra.IsSemisimple K L
